utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh yes, I heard it's this Saturday. Are you going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I'm hosting it at my place.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'll definitely stop by. Do you need any help setting up?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Gus, I'm sorry for the mix-up! Yes, I'm still interested. What time does it start at your place?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Actually, Tess, the drive got moved to Sunday at the community center, 9 to 3. Sorry for the confusion!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks Rosa for clearing that up! I must have gotten my days mixed up. See you Sunday at the community center then!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hey, just a reminder the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks Uli! I've got the supplies list ready, should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's good to hear, Cleo. Hope the weather holds up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, the repair drive? Are we sure we have the right parts for it?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Don't worry, we've got a great group together—someone always brings the right part or a clever workaround!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: But what if something goes wrong? Do we have a backup plan?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Ah, a repair drive! I'm glad I didn't bring a casserole.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what are you bringing to fix?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I've got a broken toaster that's been sitting in my closet for months. Figured it's time to see if we can revive it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: So, about the repair drive at the community center parking lot—does 10am work for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: 10am? I thought it was noon, but I'm always mixing things up. I'll be there!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Oren! See you at 10am then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Bo. Do we have a clear schedule for the repair drive? I like to know when things are happening.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center. I think it's all day, but you might want to check with Cleo for the exact times.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I already heard from Tess it's 9 to 3 at the parking lot. Good to have that settled.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Ira, did you say something about the repair drive? I want to make sure I'm following.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, Hana, it's at the community center this Saturday from 10 to 4. Bring any small items that need fixing!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks for confirming, Ira. I'll double-check my schedule and see what I can bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the tool check is Saturday morning at the community shed, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, that's it. Need any tools?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I think I'm all set, but I could use a spare screwdriver if you have one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, I heard it's at the community center parking lot from 9 to 3. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, see you there! I've told a bunch of folks already, so it should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good. Let me know if you need help setting up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, don't forget the repair drive this Saturday at the community shed, 10 AM to 4 PM. We're fixing broken items together.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik! I'll be there with my toolbox. Need me to bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Maybe bring some spare parts or snacks too. See you Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday? Yeah, I think I can make it. What time does it start again?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure this repair drive is actually going to work? I've heard some things.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center. I think it'll be fine—people are usually pretty helpful.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey! Are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard about it. Might stop by and see what's going on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great! We'll be at the community center from 10 to 4. Feel free to bring any broken items!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I'll try to stop by, but no promises. Got a lot going on.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Bo! Hope to see you there if you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's this Saturday at the community center. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Uli, it's actually Sunday at the community center. They moved it from Saturday. Still, glad you'll be there!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ah, Sunday then. Thanks for the correction.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Alright, I'll wait to hear from you about Ava's availability before finalizing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I'll check with Ava right away and let you know as soon as I hear back!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Quinn! I'll hold off on any plans until I hear from you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Did you check if the repair drive has a backup plan in case something goes wrong?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven't checked on that yet. Let me look into it before we head over tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: And are we sure we have the right parts? I'd hate to get there and realize we're missing something.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Ira, did you hear about the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure did! It's Saturday 10 to 4 at the community center—bring your broken gadgets and we'll fix 'em together.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that sounds great! I have a squeaky toaster that could use some love.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Repair drive? Oh, that sounds important. What's it about again?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's a repair drive where they fix old bikes and appliances for free. And I just learned it's actually this weekend at Gus's house, not the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, at Gus's house? Are you sure? I thought it was at the community center on Saturday...

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's awesome, Leo! If you have a socket set or a wrench, bring them along—they're always needed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, will bring socket set.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, see you Saturday morning at the shed!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Don't forget, it's this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Right, the tool check is Saturday morning at the community shed. Have you got your tools ready?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, the tool check is part of the repair drive — all day Saturday from 10 to 4 at the shed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I think we should have the tool check meeting Saturday morning at the community shed. That way we can plan the repair drive without conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, I thought the repair drive was already set for this weekend at Gus's. Are you sure we need another meeting?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: The repair drive is this weekend, but we still need a tool check meeting to make sure everything's ready. Saturday morning at the shed works for me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Gus. Do you have a plan for the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it's at my place this weekend! Got a bunch of tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Gus, I thought the drive was at the community center parking lot, not your place. Do we have a clear schedule for the day?
